title: Information Security policies are published but product/vendor inventory is not obvious from the landing page
summary: The information-security policies index is public, yet a clear student-facing inventory of EdTech vendors and data categories is not apparent from the landing page alone. Opacity about processors is an abuse-risk signal even when security policy text exists.
student_action: Ask ITS/registrar which vendors receive directory or education-record data for each portal you use.
school_action: Publish a maintained student-data processor list with purposes and retention.
